summary: This paper introduces Continuous Interaction Diffusion, a diffusion-native runtime designed for asynchronous tool-augmented reasoning in large language models. It enables LLMs to effectively utilize external tools for information access and computation.

title: Rationale-Guided Learning for Multimodal Emotion Recognition
summary: This paper proposes rationale-guided learning for multimodal emotion recognition in conversation (MERC). It aims to understand complex interactions between verbal and non-verbal cues by incorporating causal reasoning, rather than treating it as a simple input-output mapping.

title: Quantum Incremental Learning with Mixed State Prototypes
summary: This research explores quantum incremental learning with mixed state prototypes, addressing the challenge of learning new classes sequentially without catastrophic forgetting. It leverages quantum neural networks within the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era.

title: RLMOpt: Adaptive Prompt Optimization via Recursive Language Models
summary: This paper introduces RLMOpt, a method for adaptive prompt optimization via recursive language models. It automates the search for prompts to improve language model performance, addressing limitations of predefined optimization procedures.

title: Evaluating Rational Contracting in Natural Language
summary: This research focuses on evaluating rational contracting capabilities in natural language for language-based AI agents. It explores how these agents can negotiate and execute agreements, transforming machine economic activity.

title: Multi-Granular Rationale-Guided Molecular LLM for Property Prediction
summary: This paper introduces a multi-granular rationale-guided molecular large language model (LLM) for property prediction in chemical tasks. It aims to improve drug discovery by enhancing how molecular LLMs represent and predict properties from various modalities.

title: Predicting Space Groups of Double Perovskites by LLM with Dynamic Few-Shot Learning
summary: This research applies large language models (LLMs) with dynamic few-shot learning to predict the space groups of double perovskites. It addresses the challenge of predicting stable structures despite imbalanced datasets.

title: INSIDE the Student's Mind: Jointly Modeling Latent Reasoning and Action in LLM Student Simulators
summary: This paper focuses on improving LLM-based student simulators by jointly modeling latent reasoning and action. It aims to capture the underlying thought processes, which is crucial for applications like evaluating tutoring systems in education.

title: GeoForge: Non-Parametric Self-Evolving Agents for Earth-Observation Reasoning
summary: GeoForge introduces non-parametric self-evolving agents for Earth observation reasoning. These agents construct scientifically valid tool workflows and ground conclusions in geospatial evidence.

title: From Faulty Memories to Corrected Actions: Dependency-Guided Rollback Repair for Memory-Augmented Agents
summary: This paper proposes a dependency-guided rollback repair method to correct errors in persistent memory used by language-model agents. It addresses how faulty, stale, or misattributed memory records can alter agent reasoning and actions.

title: MEGA: Self-Evolving Agent Optimization Infrastructure via Wisdom Graph
summary: MEGA introduces a self-evolving optimization infrastructure for coding agents using a wisdom graph. This system aims to systematically improve agents by accumulating transferable knowledge, addressing the challenge of building scalable agent systems.

title: RadFusion: Towards Threshold-Controllable Radiology Report Generation
summary: RadFusion proposes a method for threshold-controllable radiology report generation. This aims to give clinicians control over the sensitivity-specificity trade-off of diagnostic content in automated reports.

title: Measuring Semantic Abstractness of SAE Features via Nonlocality
summary: This research proposes measuring the semantic abstractness of features in Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) via nonlocality. This aims to improve mechanistic explanations of LLM behaviors by distinguishing surface-level cues from semantic abstraction.

title: SKILLER: Language-Level Reinforcement Learning for Reusable Skill Extraction in Small Language Models
summary: SKILLER introduces a language-level reinforcement learning approach for reusable skill extraction in small language models. This method aims to package procedural knowledge and domain expertise to constrain agent behavior for high-quality task execution.

title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Laser Cutting Machine Parameter Optimization
summary: This research applies reinforcement learning to optimize parameters for laser cutting machines, aiming to achieve high accuracy in cutting optical films. The method seeks to improve parameter tuning compared to traditional trial-and-error approaches.

title: DashArena: Benchmarking LLMs on Interactive Analytic Dashboard Generation
summary: DashArena introduces a benchmark for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) on their ability to generate interactive analytic dashboards. It aims to address the difficulty of evaluating the usefulness of open-ended dashboard generation.

title: Agentic Instruction Data Selection: Let DataMaster Interpret Your Intent
summary: This paper proposes an agentic approach to instruction data selection, allowing a "DataMaster" agent to interpret user intent. This method aims to overcome the limitations of single metrics and manual inspection for selecting instruction data.

title: HexEval: An Evidence-Driven Hexagonal Framework for Multidimensional Scholar Assessment
summary: HexEval introduces an evidence-driven hexagonal framework for multidimensional scholar assessment, leveraging LLM-based approaches. This method aims to provide a more comprehensive evaluation than traditional bibliometric indicators and reputation proxies.

title: VERDICT: Training-Free Step-Wise Verification of Multimodal Reasoning via Disagreement-Aware Consensus
summary: VERDICT proposes a training-free step-wise verification method for multimodal reasoning in large language models using disagreement-aware consensus. This approach aims to address subtle errors in reasoning chains that lead to incorrect answers.

title: FITTER: Vocabulary-Agnostic Cross-Domain Inference on Temporal Knowledge Graphs
summary: FITTER introduces a vocabulary-agnostic method for cross-domain inference on temporal knowledge graphs. This approach allows models to reason about entities, relations, and timestamps even when they are unknown at training time.

title: REDAgentBench: Executable Red Teaming and Faithful Measurement of LLM Agent Systems
summary: REDAgentBench proposes an executable red teaming and measurement framework for LLM agent systems. It evaluates how adversarial inputs can exploit interactions to cause agents to violate safety policies.

title: Self-Correcting Long-Horizon Search Agents via Tree-Structured Memory
summary: This research introduces self-correcting long-horizon search agents that utilize tree-structured memory. This method addresses unbounded context growth and noise in LLM execution trajectories by providing a structured memory mechanism.

title: Ex-Omni-2D: Expressive Omni-Modal Dialogue Models with Native Visual Presence
summary: Ex-Omni-2D proposes expressive omni-modal dialogue models with native visual presence. This framework generates coordinated responses including text, personalized speech, and reference-consistent visual elements from multimodal inputs.

title: Transformer Geometry Observatory TGO-IV: Developmental Topology Observatory
summary: The Transformer Geometry Observatory TGO-IV focuses on understanding how Transformers learn by analyzing representations across isolated layers and the entire network. This contributes to interpretability studies for deep learning models.

title: Uncertainty-Aware Ensemble Deep Randomized Neural Networks for Classification
summary: This research introduces uncertainty-aware ensemble deep randomized neural networks for classification. This approach aims to improve robustness and effectiveness by addressing limitations in how current models handle diverse training samples.

title: CurveFP: Rational-Radix Logarithmic Datatypes with Closed Products for Language Models
summary: CurveFP introduces rational-radix logarithmic datatypes with closed products for language models. This innovation aims to reduce language model cost by distributing quantized magnitudes across interleaved logarithmic curves, enhancing computational efficiency.

title: Sheaf-Based Federated Representation Learning
summary: This paper proposes Sheaf-based Federated Representation Learning for heterogeneous federated systems. This method enables agents to learn and exchange informative representations despite differences in data distributions, sensing modalities, and model architectures.

title: DOCSCHISEL: Adaptive Tool Documentation Optimization Framework for LLM Agents
summary: DOCSCHISEL introduces an adaptive tool documentation optimization framework for LLM agents. This framework aims to improve the tool-use capabilities of agents by optimizing the critical grounding resource of tool documentation.

title: FlowScout: From Execution Feedback to Reliable Tool-Using Agent Workflows
summary: This paper introduces FlowScout, a system for building reliable tool-using agentic workflows by leveraging execution feedback to organize large language models, tools, and control logic. It focuses on improving the construction of high-quality agentic systems.

title: UserToolBench: A User-Profile-Hidden Benchmark for Personalized Decision Making in Tool-Use LLMs
summary: This introduces UserToolBench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate the personalized decision-making capabilities of tool-use large language models, focusing on scenarios where user profiles are hidden. It tests how well LLMs can act on users' behalf in personalized contexts.

title: Finding the Signal in the Spam: Jointly Learning Rewards and Worker Reliability from Pairwise Comparisons
summary: This research proposes a method for jointly learning item rewards and worker reliability from pairwise comparisons, which has applications in various domains, including fine-tuning large language models. The problem has been studied in recommendation systems and social choice.

title: Detecting Soft Skills in ML Engineering Roles CVs
summary: This paper explores methods for detecting soft skills in CVs for Machine Learning Engineering roles, aiming to understand candidate supply characteristics beyond what employers demand. It contributes to understanding collaboration needs among ML engineers, data scientists, and software engineers.

title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning in Prognostics and Health Management: A Systematic Literature Review
summary: This is a systematic literature review on Physics-Informed Machine Learning (PIML) within Prognostics and Health Management (PHM), highlighting how PIML addresses limitations of purely data-driven models in industrial reliability and safety. It examines advancements and challenges in the field.

title: Observational Policy Ranking for SMB Financial Guidance from Multi-Action Accounting Logs
summary: This research proposes an observational policy ranking framework to provide timely financial guidance to small and medium-sized businesses by analyzing multi-action accounting logs. It addresses the challenge of causal inference from self-selected business changes.

title: ChronoSSM: Training for Temporally Aware Representations in Autoregressive State Space Models
summary: This paper introduces ChronoSSM, a training methodology for autoregressive State Space Models to learn temporally aware representations. It aims to improve generative modeling by accounting for the 'when' of events, not just the 'what'.

title: Procedural Fairness Failures in RLHF from Preference Averaging
summary: This research identifies procedural fairness failures in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) that arise when heterogeneous human preferences are averaged into a single reward model. It explains how this can lead to majority preference groups dominating reward learning.

title: SeFoRA: Sketch-Aggregated Federated Low-Rank Adaptation with Heterogeneous Client Ranks
summary: This paper introduces SeFoRA, a method for federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large neural networks using sketch-aggregated Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). It addresses the challenge of heterogeneous LoRA ranks among clients in federated learning.

title: REATS: LLM Reasoning-based Ensemble Learning for Adaptive Time Series Forecasting
summary: This paper introduces REATS, an LLM reasoning-based ensemble learning approach for adaptive time series forecasting, which leverages LLMs to dynamically select and combine forecasting models. It aims to overcome the limitations of single models across diverse real-world time series.

title: Intrinsic Structure: Spectral Identifiability for Mechanistic Interpretability
summary: This research introduces spectral identifiability as a method to determine whether identified circuits in mechanistic interpretability are intrinsic properties of the model or artifacts of the analysis method. It addresses a fundamental challenge in understanding AI model behavior.

title: From Prediction to Incrementality: Causal Optimization for Large-Scale Targeting and Recommendation
summary: This paper proposes a causal optimization framework for large-scale targeting and recommendation systems, shifting focus from predictive scores to maximizing incremental impact in applications like marketing campaigns. It aims to improve resource allocation by considering actual business goals.

title: ELMER: Evolutionary Language Model that Explores and Refines
summary: This paper introduces ELMER, an Evolutionary Language Model designed to explore and refine programs by controlling how mutations move within behavior space. It aims to provide a more reliable measure of the impact of code changes.

title: Boundary-Seeking Policy Gradient for Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper introduces the Boundary-Seeking Policy Gradient method for safe reinforcement learning, which aims to maximize reward subject to safety constraints by ensuring the optimal policy lies on the constraint boundary. It addresses challenges in constrained Markov Decision Processes.

title: A matched-integrator evaluation of Hamiltonian neural networks on pendulum and Kepler dynamics
summary: This research provides a matched-integrator evaluation of Hamiltonian Neural Networks (HNNs) against parameter-matched feedforward neural networks for modeling conservative dynamics. It assesses the architectural prior benefit of HNNs on systems like pendulums and Kepler dynamics.

title: STCAD: Scalable Trajectory Clustering and Anomaly Detection on Terabyte-Scale AIS Data
summary: This paper introduces STCAD, a scalable framework for unsupervised clustering and anomaly detection of maritime trajectories from terabyte-scale AIS data. It uses a custom BERT-based model to encode variable-length trajectories.

title: CRHT: A Continuous Regression Hybrid Transformer for Vessel Trajectory Prediction with Online Cluster Sampling
summary: This paper proposes the Continuous Regression Hybrid Transformer (CRHT), a deep learning framework for accurate vessel trajectory prediction that addresses geographic bias and navigational realism using online cluster sampling. It aims to improve maritime safety and anomaly detection.

title: Toward Human Rights Benchmarking for LLMs: A Pilot Methodology
summary: This research presents efforts to develop a robust and scalable pilot methodology for benchmarking Large Language Models on their ability to reason correctly about human rights law. It addresses the lack of evaluation benchmarks in this crucial area.

title: Power law graph attention: exact generalization of scaled dot-product attention, empirical collapse at inference
summary: This paper introduces Power Law Graph Attention (PLGA), an exact generalization of scaled dot-product attention for Large Language Models, which replaces the fixed bilinear form with a learned, input-generated operator. It observes empirical collapse at inference.

title: MERA: Model Evolution and Routing with Skill Adaptation for Agentic Systems at Scale
summary: This paper introduces MERA, a system designed to improve LLM agentic systems at scale through model evolution and routing with skill adaptation. It optimizes heterogeneous model calls within tasks, assigning easier invocations to cheaper models.

title: Accelerated Learning of High Dimensional Functions with a Tensor-Featured Training Network
summary: This paper presents a method using contextual features in the first layer of a deep neural network to accelerate the optimization of learning high-dimensional functions.

title: Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agentic Tasks
summary: This research explores efficient reinforcement learning for long-horizon agentic tasks that involve tool use, reasoning over user goals, and managing delayed verifiable rewards.

title: Fisher8: Stabilizing Neural Heteroscedastic Regression via Output-Layer Fisher Geometry
summary: This paper proposes Fisher8, a method to stabilize neural heteroscedastic regression by aligning gradient steps with the output-layer Fisher geometry.

title: Generator-Guided Inverse Sampling for L\'evy-Driven Generative Models
summary: This paper investigates inverse sampling for Lévy-driven generative models from the perspective of Markov generators, focusing on their non-local reverse processes.

title: Dreamer-SAC: Off-Policy Learning in Latent World Models for Sample-Efficient Autonomous Driving
summary: This work introduces Dreamer-SAC, an off-policy reinforcement learning approach in latent world models to achieve sample-efficient policy optimization for autonomous driving.

title: Share First, Route What Remains: A Unified Framework for Token-Adaptive MoE Computation
summary: This paper proposes a unified framework for token-adaptive Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) computation, combining shared-expert designs, fine-grained computation, and dynamic routing.

title: ELVAE: Evidential Learning-Based Variational Autoencoder for Uncertainty-Aware Generation
summary: This paper formulates ELVAE, an evidential learning-based Variational Autoencoder designed for uncertainty-aware generation that distinguishes between latent location uncertainty and variability.

title: Do Judges Behave Like Algorithms?
summary: This article poses a philosophical question about whether human judges already behave in predictable, algorithmic-like ways, particularly in the context of AI deployment in judicial systems.

title: TideRL: Boosting Agentic RL Goodput with Readiness-Aware Scheduling
summary: This research introduces TideRL, a scheduling method to boost the goodput of agentic reinforcement learning for multi-turn workloads by managing variable task durations and contexts.

title: Actionable Hallucination Detection: Translating Latent Uncertainty into Agentic Critique
summary: This paper addresses hallucination detection in LLM-based AI agents by translating latent uncertainty into actionable critiques for real-time correction of grounding failures.

title: Do Time-Series Forecasters Use the Right History: Recoverability, Recovery, and Functional Use of Temporal Delays
summary: This paper analyzes how time-series models use historical data, examining the recoverability of true delays, model reporting of delays, and their functional use in forecasting.

title: Detecting an Effect Is Not Learning to Act on It: A Reward-SNR Floor for LLM Acquisition Agents
summary: This work explores the distinction between detecting an effect and learning to act on it for LLM acquisition agents, focusing on when an acquired signal is valuable.

title: Critic-Free Pretraining for Efficient Online Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning
summary: This paper proposes critic-free pretraining to enable more efficient online fine-tuning in offline-to-online reinforcement learning by avoiding issues with static, pre-trained critics.

title: Exploration-Driven Personalized Federated Reinforcement Learning via Intrinsic Motivation
summary: This paper presents a method for Personalized Federated Reinforcement Learning that uses exploration-driven intrinsic motivation to improve decentralized policy learning while maintaining client data privacy.

title: Retrieval-Corrected Conformal Prediction for Time Series
summary: This paper introduces retrieval-corrected conformal prediction, a method to provide more efficient and robust prediction intervals for time series data by adapting to changing forecast errors.

title: BREAD: Baseline-Referenced Explanations for Anomaly Diagnosis
summary: This paper introduces BREAD, a method for generating baseline-referenced explanations to diagnose anomalies detected by AI-based statistical process monitoring systems in high-dimensional settings.

title: $\beta$-VAEs as Effective Theories: Tolerance-Dependent Dimension
summary: This paper analyzes $\beta$-VAEs, showing how increased regularization strength acts as a spectral cutoff by collapsing low-utility latent coordinates and exploring its dependence on reconstruction utility.

title: Compute-Optimal Is Not Cluster-Optimal: Systems-Aware Scaling for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
summary: This paper argues for systems-aware scaling for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts models in large-scale pretraining, optimizing implementation across algorithm, architecture, and system decisions for cluster efficiency.

title: Pair-Centric Graph Rewiring for Over-Squashing via Optimal Transport-Guided Communication Alignment
summary: This paper proposes pair-centric graph rewiring, guided by optimal transport, to address the over-squashing problem in Message-Passing Neural Networks by improving communication alignment across distant graph regions.

title: ProbGuard: Calibrated Safety Risk Estimation from LLM Output Distributions
summary: This paper introduces ProbGuard, a method for calibrated safety risk estimation from Large Language Model output distributions, moving beyond deterministic classification for identifying unsafe LLM outputs.

title: IADD-TR: Intervention-Aware Dynamics Decoupling with Targeted Regularization for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper introduces a method called IADD-TR for model-based reinforcement learning, aiming to improve dynamics prediction and policy optimization through intervention-aware dynamics decoupling and targeted regularization. It addresses challenges in sample-efficient decision-making.

title: Optimize Cheap, Deploy Strong: Cost-Aware Cross-Tier Transfer for Evolutionary Optimization
summary: This paper proposes a cost-aware cross-tier transfer method for the evolutionary optimization of LLM prompts and agentic programs. It aims to reduce the total search cost by restructuring the fitness evaluation process.

title: ProTAGAD: A Foundation Model for TAG Anomaly Detection with Decoupled Topological and Textual Prototypes
summary: This paper introduces ProTAGAD, a foundation model designed for anomaly detection in Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs). It uses decoupled topological and textual prototypes to identify anomalies in applications such as LLM security and social network moderation.

title: Your LLM, Your Style: Behavioral Mode Axes for LLM Behavioral Control
summary: This research investigates behavioral mode axes for controlling large language models' styles in interactive settings. It aims to improve understanding of how LLM behavioral styles affect user experience, safety, and decision-making.

title: Path Integral Value Matching for Linear Quadratic Stochastic Optimal Control
summary: This paper presents a Path Integral Value Matching method for Linear Quadratic Stochastic Optimal Control. It aims to address the prohibitive computational costs typically associated with current state-of-the-art policy-based methods in this framework.

title: MoE Proxy Models for Low-Cost Failure Reproduction and Diagnosis in LLM RL Post-Training
summary: This paper introduces MoE Proxy Models to enable low-cost failure reproduction and diagnosis in the computationally intensive reinforcement learning post-training of large language models. It aims to simplify debugging and address complexities arising from system pipelines and numerical issues.

title: TACTICL: Task-Aware Compression of Tabular ICL Models
summary: This paper introduces TACTICL, an automated task-aware compression method for tabular in-context learning models. It aims to reduce inference costs and computational demands by distilling models into more efficient, task-specific architectures.

title: LLM Agents Factory: Retrieval of Domain-Specific LLM Agents
summary: This paper proposes the LLM Agents Factory for the retrieval of domain-specific LLM agents, addressing the computational cost and instability of on-the-fly agent design. It aims to improve practical deployment of agents that decompose problems into specialized behaviors.

title: Carefully Considering Culture: Analyzing LLM Alignment in Single- and Multi-Cultural Settings using Cultural Consensus Theory
summary: This research analyzes large language model alignment in single- and multi-cultural settings using Cultural Consensus Theory. It investigates LLM understanding of cultural norms, considering group consensus and diverse cultural environments.

title: The Multilingual Quantization Tax: Structural Collapse and Typological Fragility in Edge SLMs
summary: This paper examines the "multilingual quantization tax," which refers to the performance degradation and structural collapse observed when deploying 4-bit quantized Small Language Models (SLMs) on edge devices. It highlights the typological fragility of SLMs under quantization in multilingual contexts.

title: When Chain-of-Thought Helps and When It Hurts: An Empirical Investigation of the Serial-Depth Bottleneck in LLM Reasoning
summary: This empirical investigation explores when Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting benefits or harms large language model reasoning, specifically focusing on the serial-depth bottleneck. It examines the widely assumed universal improvement of CoT prompting.

title: Position Encoding in Transformers: From Absolute and Relative Methods to Rotary Position Embeddings and Long-Context Scaling
summary: This paper provides an overview of position encoding in Transformer models, covering methods from absolute and relative approaches to Rotary Position Embeddings. It discusses how position encoding addresses the lack of token order information in self-attention models and its relevance for long-context scaling.

title: PERCEPT: A Corpus for POS Tagging and Analysis of Persian-English Code-Mixing
summary: This paper introduces PERCEPT, a new corpus specifically developed for Part-of-Speech tagging and analysis of Persian-English code-mixing in social media. It aims to address the underexplored area of Persian-English code-mixed data in multilingual communication.

title: The Parser Already Knows: Lightweight Bias Correction in Constrained Decoding
summary: This paper proposes a lightweight bias correction method for Grammar Constrained Decoding (GCD) in language models. It aims to mitigate the distortion of a model's probability distribution when masking non-conforming tokens, which can lead to suboptimal outputs.

title: Multimodal Item Parameter Estimation using Simulated Response Probabilitie
summary: This research presents results on reconstructing multiple-choice model and three-parameter logistic model curves using a fine-tuned multimodal large language model based on Qwen3.5. The LLM is prompted and fine-tuned to replicate choice probabilities from a large training corpus.

title: Similarity Gates Approve Reversals: A Validity Audit of Embedding-Cosine Thresholds in Agent Systems
summary: This paper conducts a validity audit of embedding-cosine thresholds used in similarity gates within AI agent systems. It examines how these gates, deployed in features like deduplication filters and semantic caches, determine whether text blocks are semantically equivalent.

title: Off-Axis, On Purpose: Where a Transformer Computes Concepts and Why it Does So
summary: This research investigates how Transformers compute concepts, focusing on the functional role of off-axis intermediate states rather than just the final unembedded answer. It reveals that a 12-layer model computes in two distinct phases.

title: TAF-MED: Multi-Turn Safety Refusal Collapse in LLMs Under Declared Self-Treatment Intent
summary: This paper introduces TAF-MED to study multi-turn safety refusal collapse in large language models when users declare self-treatment intent regarding health information. It investigates whether LLM medication-safety boundaries persist across follow-up interactions.

title: Locally Deployable Small Language Models for Emergency Department Decision Support: A Systematic Benchmark of Fine-Tuning Strategies
summary: This research systematically benchmarks fine-tuning strategies for locally deployable small language models intended for emergency department decision support. It addresses challenges like privacy risks and the need for robust evaluation of open-source models in sensitive environments.

title: Cracks in the Foundation: Seemingly Minor Architectural Choices Impact Long Context Extension
summary: This research paper investigates how minor architectural choices within transformer models significantly impact their accuracy and performance in long context settings.

title: Co-Evolution in Agentic Systems: Toward Self-Directed Evolution Beyond Human Design
summary: This survey explores co-evolution in agentic systems, examining how multiple interacting components can achieve self-directed improvement beyond fixed learning contexts.

title: Is This Your Final Answer? Cross-Contextual Consistency as a Measure of LLM Credibility
summary: This paper introduces cross-contextual consistency as a new behavioral measure to evaluate whether Large Language Models provide answers based on stable understanding or merely pattern matching.

title: VisEditBench: Can Vision-Language Models Edit Visualization Code from Multimodal Feedback?
summary: This paper introduces VisEditBench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of Vision-Language Models to iteratively edit visualization code based on multimodal feedback.

title: How Robust Are LLMs to Vietnamese Dialects?
summary: This research assesses the robustness of Large Language Models when processing various regional Vietnamese dialects, contrasting their performance against evaluations based on standard written Vietnamese.

title: From Reasoning Depth to Reasoning Breadth: Evaluating Multi-Point Associative Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: This paper evaluates Large Language Models on their "reasoning breadth," a complementary capability to reasoning depth that involves exploring multiple semantic dimensions for associative reasoning tasks.

title: MD-ProTector: Positioning Multiple Data-Driven Prototypes for LLM-Generated Text Detection
summary: This paper introduces MD-ProTector, a new system that uses multiple data-driven prototypes to detect LLM-generated text across diverse writing styles, domains, and languages.

title: Calibrating Post-Training Feature Shifts for LLM Data Contamination Detection
summary: This research proposes methods for detecting data contamination in Large Language Models by calibrating post-training feature shifts to determine if specific text was part of the pre-training corpus.

title: Every Token Counts: Exact Likert-Scale Distributions for Measuring LLM Attitudes and Biases
summary: This paper proposes using exact Likert-scale distributions to precisely measure the latent attitudes and biases of Large Language Models, offering an alternative to typical unstructured benchmarks.

title: ASR-Roundtrip Evaluation Can Mask Context- and Convention-Dependent Reading Errors in Chinese News TTS
summary: This research demonstrates that ASR-roundtrip evaluation can fail to detect context- and convention-dependent reading errors in Chinese news text-to-speech (TTS) systems, masking issues perceived by human listeners.

title: Simplex Relaxation for Discrete Diffusion
summary: This research explores uniform discrete diffusion models, investigating their corruption kernel and reverse prediction problem, and proposing simplex relaxation to enrich their training objective.

title: Dual-Loop Self-Evolution via Verifiable Emotion Feedback for Multi-Turn Empathetic Dialogue
summary: This research proposes a dual-loop self-evolution mechanism with verifiable emotion feedback to enhance Large Language Models' empathetic competence in multi-turn dialogue.

title: Decomposition-Induced Context-Memory Conflict: When Fact-Checking Pipelines Contradict Their Own Source Text
summary: This research identifies that decompose-then-verify fact-checking pipelines can introduce context-memory conflicts, causing them to contradict their own source text due to the decomposition process.

title: Seeds Before Objectives: Rethinking Evaluation for Low-Resource Garhwali ASR
summary: This paper critiques current evaluation methods for low-resource ASR, specifically for Garhwali, and introduces the first reproducible multi-seed ASR benchmark for this under-resourced language.

title: Auditing Chinese Web-scale Corpora via Sampled BPE Token Statistics
summary: This research proposes a method for auditing Chinese web-scale corpora using sampled BPE token statistics to identify pollution at a fine-grained level, addressing challenges of scale and analysis.

title: Can Released LLM Vocabularies Support Token-Level Estimation of Hidden Corpora?
summary: This research investigates whether released Large Language Model vocabularies can be used to estimate token-level composition and corpus ratios of their hidden pretraining corpora.

title: SPIEval: Evaluating Large Language Models as Mobile Assistants over Scattered Personal Information
summary: This paper introduces SPIEval, a new benchmark designed to evaluate Large Language Models' capabilities as mobile assistants, specifically their ability to utilize personal information scattered across various applications.

title: EVIL-Detect for NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 6: LLM-Generated Text Detection
summary: This paper presents EVIL-Detect, a multi-signature system for detecting LLM-generated text in realistic Chinese scenarios, developed for the NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 6.

title: Most biomedical publications show signs of LLM-assisted writing
summary: This study reports that most biomedical publications show evidence of Large Language Model-assisted writing, highlighting a widespread use with potential implications for academic integrity.

title: Mitigating Context Interference for Reliable and Efficient Search Agents
summary: This paper investigates and proposes strategies for mitigating context interference in multi-turn LLM-powered search agents, aiming to improve their reliability and efficiency when handling complex and lengthy contexts.

title: Assessing Reliability of BERT-Based Models on Question Answering Tasks
summary: This research assesses the reliability of BERT-based models on question answering tasks, focusing on methods for estimating trustworthiness and robustness crucial for practical applications.

title: Surfacing the Unsaid: CUE-Bench for Affective Stance in Chinese Discourse
summary: This introduces CUE-Bench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate affective stance in Chinese discourse, addressing the limitations of existing emotion benchmarks that primarily focus on surface sentiment.

title: Reference-Free Post-Training of Open Large Language Models for Multilingual Machine Translation
summary: This study explores reference-free post-training for multilingual machine translation using open large language models, applying Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to fine-tuned models like MiLMMT-46-v0.1.

title: VibeLifeBench: Can Your Life Agent Be Proactive and Persistent in a Living World?
summary: This paper introduces VibeLifeBench, a new benchmark to evaluate the proactive and persistent capabilities of LLM agents acting as personal assistants in dynamic, long-term real-world scenarios.

title: X2-Turn: Frame-Synchronous Dual-Head Modeling for Joint Streaming ASR and Turn State Prediction
summary: This research proposes X2-Turn, a frame-synchronous dual-head modeling approach for joint streaming Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and real-time turn state prediction in spoken dialogue systems.

title: FaithformBench: Benchmarking Faithfulness of Mathematical Chain-of-Thought Autoformalisation
summary: This introduces FaithformBench, a new benchmark specifically for assessing the faithfulness of mathematical Chain-of-Thought Autoformalisation (AF) systems in mapping natural language reasoning to formal statements.

title: A Cost-Efficient Routing Pipeline for Multilingual Short-Text Classification Using Small Language Models
summary: This work presents a cost-efficient routing pipeline for multilingual short-text classification, utilizing small language models to support operational systems like content moderation and customer support.

title: REAP: Relation-Aware Elicitation and Parsing for Closed-Book Knowledge Base Construction from LLMs
summary: This paper presents REAP, a system for constructing knowledge bases from large language models in a closed-book setting, using structured chain-of-thought reasoning and relation-specific query strategies.

title: ReLTEx: Reliable LLM-based Taxonomy Expansion
summary: This research introduces ReLTEx, a system for reliable LLM-based taxonomy expansion that addresses issues like noisy, redundant, or hierarchical errors when generating semantic concepts and relations.

title: MUSE: A Full-Text Cross-Domain Knowledge Base of Scientific Problems, Solutions, and Rationales
summary: This introduces MUSE (Mining Underlying Scientific Explanations), a new full-text, cross-domain knowledge base that extracts scientific problems, solutions, and their rationales from research papers.

title: What Iterated Self-Feeding Probes of Language Models Measure, and a test that separates the construction from the model
summary: This research investigates what iterated self-feeding probes (like self-consistency and agentic loops) truly measure in language models, proposing a test to separate the probe's construction from the model's behavior.

title: ConRub-Med: Reinforcement Learning with Consensus Rubrics for Open-Ended Medical Question Answering
summary: This presents ConRub-Med, a reinforcement learning approach using consensus rubrics for open-ended medical question answering, addressing the challenge of verifying complex medical responses.

title: On the Limitations of Cross-Lingual Consistency in Multilingual Text-to-image Generation
summary: This introduces LingT2I, a new benchmark designed to investigate cross-lingual consistency limitations and performance gaps in multilingual text-to-image generation, moving beyond English-only evaluations.

title: Templated or fully Synthetic? Prompt construction as a confound in measuring LLM political stance beyond writing assistance
summary: This research analyzes prompt construction as a confounding factor in measuring LLM political stance, highlighting limitations of existing evaluation methods like closed-ended surveys and the IssueBench framework.

title: Data Attribution of Emergent Misalignment with Persona Features
summary: This research investigates emergent misalignment (EM), where fine-tuning a language model for one task leads to harmful behavior in others, attributing this phenomenon to amplified persona features from pre-training.

title: myMediWhisper: Construction of Burmese Medical Speech Corpus and Whisper Fine-Tuning for Clinical Dialogue ASR
summary: This work presents myMediWhisper, a framework for Burmese medical speech recognition, involving the construction of a high-quality Burmese medical speech corpus and fine-tuning Whisper models for clinical dialogue ASR.

title: TEAMMix: Taxonomy Enrichment Augmentation and Minority-augmented Mixing Strategy for LLM-enhanced Weak-Supervised Hierarchical Text Classification
summary: This paper introduces TEAMMix, a new strategy combining taxonomy enrichment augmentation and a minority-augmented mixing strategy for LLM-enhanced weak-supervised hierarchical text classification.

title: Multiclass Sentiment Analysis for Identifying Political Viewpoints
summary: This article discusses the application of multiclass sentiment analysis to identify political viewpoints within social media discourse, leveraging NLP to analyze public opinions and perspectives.

title: Attention-Path Fragility as an Uncertainty Signal in Large Language Models
summary: This research proposes 'Attention-Path Fragility' as a new uncertainty signal in large language models, instantiated as ASMI, which measures how confident predictions change under perturbation of attention pathways.

title: The Illusion of Cross-Lingual Safety in Low-Resource Languages
summary: This research investigates the 'illusion of cross-lingual safety' in large language models, revealing how safety alignments developed in English often fail to generalize to low-resource languages, exposing vulnerabilities.

title: From Interpretability to Control: Insights from Six Years of the TrustNLP Workshop
summary: A workshop documenting the evolution of trustworthy Natural Language Processing (NLP), highlighting the field's transition from post-hoc interpretability to mechanistic understanding and proactive control of AI models.

title: ConVAWG: A Retrieval-Grounded Framework for Controlled Synthetic Dialogue Generation in Violence Against Women and Girls
summary: ConVAWG is a retrieval-grounded framework designed for controlled synthetic dialogue generation, enabling the study of conversational dynamics in sensitive domains like violence against women and girls where real data is difficult to access.

title: LEGO: Leveled Language Gaussian Splatting
summary: LEGO introduces Leveled Language Gaussian Splatting for advanced open-vocabulary scene understanding, innovating by capturing intrinsic semantic hierarchies within a scene beyond basic concept recognition.

title: 4D-WAM: 4D Consistent World Modeling for Autonomous Driving
summary: 4D-WAM is a new World-Action Model (WAM) designed for autonomous driving, aiming to improve future driving scene evolution and trajectory planning by consistently modeling 4D driving scenes rather than relying on 2D video projections.

title: P3CA: Encoder-Agnostic Interpretation of Vision Foundation Model Embeddings via Spatial Probing
summary: P3CA (position-prompted PCA) is an encoder-agnostic method proposed for interpreting high-dimensional spatial embeddings of vision foundation models, particularly useful in medical image computing to inspect beyond task performance.

title: MAD-HOI: Masked Autoregressive Diffusion for Generating Articulated Hand Object Interactions from Text
summary: MAD-HOI introduces a Masked Autoregressive Diffusion method for generating articulated hand-object interaction sequences from text, supporting features like variable-length generation and motion completion for more utilitarian outputs.

title: Motion Artifact-Aware Self-Supervised Representation Learning for 3D Brain MRI Motion Artifact Reduction
summary: This research focuses on Motion Artifact-Aware Self-Supervised Representation Learning to reduce motion artifacts in 3D Brain MRI, addressing image degradation caused by patient movement in quantitative analysis.

title: DoseBridge: Denoising Diffusion Bridge Model for Dose Prediction in Lung Intensity-Modulated Proton Therapy
summary: DoseBridge is a denoising diffusion bridge model developed for accurate dose prediction in Lung Intensity-Modulated Proton Therapy, improving upon existing models by integrating beam geometry despite small clinical datasets.

title: Human versus Computer Vision
summary: This study rigorously tests leading computer vision saliency models against 11.4 million webcam gaze points from 3,023 US adults to compare their predictions of human attention with actual human visual behavior.

title: More Accurate, Less Human: Gestalt Grouping in Vision Models
summary: This research investigates whether vision models employ Gestalt grouping principles to organize visual content similarly to human vision, examining how they perceive wholes from parts.

title: A Convolutional Layer Activation Dimensionality Reduction for Out-of-Distribution and Adversarial Attack Detection Methods
summary: This paper proposes a Convolutional Layer Activation Dimensionality Reduction method for detecting out-of-distribution and adversarial attack samples, addressing trustworthiness and safety concerns in convolutional neural networks.

title: Chain of Spatial Thoughts: Modality-Agnostic Spatial Grounding for Vision Language Models
summary: Chain of Spatial Thoughts explores Modality-Agnostic Spatial Grounding for Vision Language Models, a fundamental capability for embodied intelligence applications such as robotic manipulation and autonomous driving.

title: TRACE-GS: On-Policy Trajectory Distillation with Privileged Geometric Conditioning for Sparse-View 3DGS Restoration
summary: TRACE-GS presents an on-policy trajectory distillation framework that uses privileged geometric conditioning to adapt a diffusion prior for sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) restoration.

title: SeFaR: Semantic Feature-aware Robustness Testing of Deep Neural Networks
summary: SeFaR introduces a Semantic Feature-aware Robustness Testing method for Deep Neural Networks, aiming to evaluate perception models for reliability in safety-critical domains where failures can arise from rare scenarios.

title: MRIComp4Flow: Compression of 3D Brain MRI for Training Multi-Modal Generative Models
summary: MRIComp4Flow focuses on the compression of 3D Brain MRI data to facilitate the training of large-scale multi-modal generative models, addressing challenges related to storage and I/O costs.

title: Frozen Brain-MRI Foundation Models Are Site Fingerprints
summary: This research audits frozen foundation-model embeddings used for brain-MRI representations, discovering that acquisition site is a significant, intrinsic component encoded within the representations, contrary to assumptions of purely anatomical capture.

title: UniMod: Enhancing Multi-Modal Medical Diagnosis through Cross-Modality and Within-Modality Alignment
summary: UniMod is a method for enhancing multi-modal medical diagnosis by addressing shortcut learning through cross-modality and within-modality alignment, ensuring models effectively utilize both image and text data.

title: From Detection to Understanding: TAR and TAR-Bench for Multi-Task Traffic Anomaly Reasoning
summary: TAR and TAR-Bench are introduced as new datasets and resources for training and evaluating video-language models, specifically designed for multi-task traffic anomaly reasoning beyond simple anomaly detection.

title: ENCORE: Efficient Noise Context-Aware Representation for Low-Dose CT Denoising
summary: This paper proposes ENCORE, an efficient noise context-aware representation model designed for low-dose CT denoising, which addresses limitations of conventional models by accounting for non-stationary and spatially correlated CT noise.

title: CasDeblurGS: Cascaded 2D-to-3D Multi-View Consistency for 3D Gaussian Splatting from Two Blurry Images
summary: This paper introduces CasDeblurGS, a method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses cascaded 2D-to-3D multi-view consistency to reconstruct 3D scenes from two blurry images, aiming to improve practical capture in immersive applications.

title: A second-order theory of texture for depth from focus
summary: This paper presents a second-order theory of texture for depth from focus based on wave optics, explaining how even traditionally textureless surfaces can produce textured appearance for depth perception.

title: DriveVLA-M0: Failure-Aware Memory Augmentation for Autonomous Driving
summary: This paper introduces DriveVLA-M0, a failure-aware memory augmentation method for Vision-Language-Action models in autonomous driving, designed to help systems learn from past failures and adapt to distribution shifts.

title: GeoSeg-OV: Bridging Geospatial Gaps with Structural Guidance for Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation
summary: This paper proposes GeoSeg-OV, a method that uses structural guidance to bridge geospatial gaps for open-vocabulary remote sensing segmentation, enabling pixel-level recognition of arbitrary categories specified by natural language.

title: Lesion-Aware Adaptive Fourier Neural Operator for CT-to-PSMA PET Synthesis in Prostate Cancer
summary: This paper introduces a lesion-aware adaptive Fourier neural operator for synthesizing PSMA PET images from CT scans in prostate cancer, aiming to improve accuracy by optimizing for tumor voxels.

title: DynaPPI: A Large-scale Dynamic Protein Dataset for AI-driven Advances in Protein Interactomics
summary: This paper introduces DynaPPI, a large-scale dynamic protein dataset designed to advance AI-driven research in protein interactomics, specifically for predicting the structure of multi-chain protein aggregates.

title: MammoMix: Leveraging Mixture of Experts for Robust Mammogram Breast Detection
summary: This paper proposes MammoMix, a method leveraging Mixture of Experts for robust breast lesion detection in mammography, addressing challenges like variations in image quality and demographics.

title: Stream Forcing: Constructing Unified Training Trajectory for Robust Streaming Video Generation
summary: This paper introduces 'Stream Forcing,' a method for constructing a unified training trajectory to achieve robust streaming video generation, addressing the train-inference mismatch in video diffusion models.

title: FUSE: Frame-Unified Stress Estimation from Facial Video
summary: This paper presents FUSE, a method for frame-unified stress estimation from facial video, offering a practical path to non-intrusive affect monitoring by improving upon existing video-based classification approaches.

title: Bridging Event Streams and DiT: Event-Guided Video Frame Interpolation
summary: This paper introduces a method that bridges event streams and Diffusion Transformers (DiT) for event-guided video frame interpolation, aiming to improve synthesis of intermediate frames and handle complex motion.

title: When Vision Becomes Text: Visual Token Pruning via Cross-Modal Residual Guidance in VLMs
summary: This paper proposes a method for visual token pruning via cross-modal residual guidance in Vision-Language Models (VLMs), aiming to reduce inference costs while maintaining performance.

title: SapiensID 2.0: Aligning Human Recognition Foundation Models with Human Perception
summary: This paper introduces SapiensID 2.0, a method for aligning human recognition foundation models with human perception, addressing limitations like 'semantic blindness' in current models that rely on static feature extraction.

title: DSAR: Dual-Stream Autoregressive Modeling of Temporal Cloth Dynamics for Photorealistic Animatable Avatars
summary: This paper presents DSAR, a dual-stream autoregressive modeling approach for temporal cloth dynamics, aimed at creating photorealistic and temporally coherent animatable human avatars from RGB videos.

title: SafeCap: Improving LVLM Safety with Image Captioning Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper proposes SafeCap, a reinforcement-learning framework that aligns large vision-language models (LVLMs) through learned self-captioning to improve their safety and mitigate jailbreak attacks.

title: SparSTAR: Sparse Attention for SpaceTime AutoRegressive Video Synthesis
summary: This paper introduces SparSTAR, a method that uses sparse attention for SpaceTime AutoRegressive Video Synthesis, extending visual autoregressive generation to video by improving efficiency in attention mechanisms.

title: Unlocking the Power of Medical Tabular Data via Semantic-Aware Multimodal Pre-training
summary: This paper proposes a method for semantic-aware multimodal pre-training to unlock the potential of medical tabular data, aiming to better integrate it with vision-language models for medical representation learning.

title: Rethinking Text-Based Image Retrieval in Specific Domain
summary: This paper rethinks Text-Based Image Retrieval (TBIR) in specific domains, critically analyzing existing benchmarks and their single-match assumption in light of advancements in vision-language representation learning.

title: Dynamic Context Adapters: Efficiently Infusing History into Vision-and-Language Models
summary: This paper proposes Dynamic Context Adapters, a method for efficiently infusing historical context into Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to improve their performance in sequential decision-making tasks requiring temporal understanding.

title: Flow Straight to Reality: Perceptually Consistent Flow Matching for Efficient Image Restoration
summary: This paper introduces 'Flow Straight to Reality,' a method utilizing perceptually consistent flow matching for efficient image restoration, aiming to balance the tradeoff between distortion and perceptual realism.

title: $\pi$-SUB: A Physics-Informed Synthetic Underwater Benchmark Dataset for Underwater Image Enhancement
summary: This paper introduces $\pi$-SUB, a physics-informed framework for generating synthetic underwater benchmark datasets to improve Underwater Image Enhancement (UIE).

title: Rethinking Data Efficiency in Industrial Dense Prediction: Pretraining Coherence, Not Inductive Bias, Determines ViTs Low-Data Advantage
summary: This research investigates why Vision Transformers (ViTs) struggle with data efficiency in industrial dense prediction, attributing the gap to pretraining incoherence rather than inductive bias.

title: InSight-doc: Agentic Visual Perception for Long-Document Understanding
summary: This paper proposes InSight-doc, an agentic visual perception framework designed to improve long-document understanding by adaptively managing visual resolution as a reasoning resource.

title: MedUP: Awakening Unified Understanding and Perception in Medical Vision-Language Models
summary: This paper introduces MedUP, a method to enhance the unified understanding, visual perception, segmentation, and grounding capabilities of Medical Vision-Language Models (Med-VLMs).

title: Precise Top-Layer Fabric Segmentation for Fabric Destacking with Edge- and Shape-Aware Deep Networks
summary: This research focuses on precise top-layer fabric segmentation for fabric destacking, utilizing edge- and shape-aware deep networks to address complexities like subtle boundaries and visual similarities.

title: PolypVision: A Three-Stage Hierarchical Deep Learning Framework for Classification and Segmentation of Colorectal Polyps
summary: This paper presents PolypVision, a three-stage hierarchical deep learning framework for the classification and segmentation of colorectal polyps to aid in early detection of colorectal cancer.

title: Cross-View Sequential Visual Localization with Spatio-Temporal Context Modeling for Autonomous Driving
summary: This research proposes a method for cross-view sequential visual localization using spatio-temporal context modeling to provide continuous and reliable positioning for autonomous driving systems.

title: Bridging Severe Cross-Modal Misalignment: End-to-End Visible-Infrared Object Detection via Explicit Feature-Domain Affine Registration
summary: This paper presents an end-to-end visible-infrared object detection method that uses explicit feature-domain affine registration to address severe cross-modal spatial misalignment.

title: Visual Geometry Foundation-Aware Gaussians for Single-Frame Surround-View Driving Reconstruction
summary: This research proposes Visual Geometry Foundation-Aware Gaussians to improve single-frame surround-view driving reconstruction, addressing geometric instability and rendering artifacts caused by minimal inter-camera overlap.

title: Embedding Rotation Invariance for Provable Multi-Oriented Scene Text Recognition
summary: This paper introduces a method for embedding rotation invariance to achieve provable multi-oriented scene text recognition, aiming to overcome the limitations of existing rotation-aware approaches.

title: MMArt A Multi-Perspective Multimodal Dataset for Visual Art Understanding
summary: This paper introduces MMArt, a multi-perspective multimodal dataset designed to improve vision-language models' ability to deeply understand visual art beyond surface-level descriptions.

title: Self-Geometry: GT-Free and Plug-and-Play Test-Time Adaptation for Geometrically Consistent 3D Vision Foundation Models
summary: This paper proposes Self-Geometry, a ground truth-free and plug-and-play test-time adaptation method for ensuring geometric consistency in 3D Vision Foundation Models.

title: Compact Feed-Forward 3D Gaussians via Saliency-Guided Primitive Merging
summary: This paper introduces a method for creating compact feed-forward 3D Gaussians using saliency-guided primitive merging to optimize 3D scene reconstruction and rendering.

title: Grid-Preserving Knowledge Distillation: Transferring Convolutional Inductive Bias to Vision Transformers under Data Scarcity
summary: This research proposes Grid-Preserving Knowledge Distillation to effectively transfer convolutional inductive bias to Vision Transformers, improving their performance in data-scarce training scenarios.

title: InterPruner: Interactive Structured Pruning via Taylor-Implicit Criterion and Language-Prior Modulator for Multimodal Object Detection
summary: This paper introduces InterPruner, an interactive structured pruning method utilizing a Taylor-implicit criterion and language-prior modulator to optimize multimodal object detection in remote sensing by reducing redundancy.

title: Rethinking LLM Verification: Evidence Structure, Uncertainty, and Selective Refinement
summary: This research rethinks LLM verification by proposing a two-stage framework that considers evidence structure, uncertainty, and selective refinement to enhance reliability in medical applications.

title: Beyond Pixels: From Video Priors to 4D Worlds
summary: This paper explores advancements in 4D generation, synthesizing dynamic 3D scenes from video priors to overcome limitations of existing methods in reconstructing geometry.

title: Protection Levels for Vision-Based Pose Estimation
summary: This research investigates protection levels for vision-based pose estimation to provide integrity guarantees and fault detection for navigation systems, addressing certification demands.

title: The Impact of Operational-Data Fidelity when Assessing Safety-Critical Autonomous-Vehicle Software
summary: This paper examines the impact of operational-data fidelity on assessing the reliability of safety-critical autonomous-vehicle software by evaluating past success and failure events.

title: Navigating the Proximity-Safety Balance: Constraint Decomposition for Human Following in Pedestrian Crowds
summary: This research addresses the challenge of human following in crowded pedestrian environments by proposing constraint decomposition to balance proximity and safety for robotic systems.

title: Whole-Body Planning for Humanoids Navigating Confined Spaces via Self-Collision Avoidance References
summary: This paper presents a whole-body planning method for humanoid robots to navigate confined spaces by addressing self-collision avoidance and maintaining multi-contact dynamic feasibility.

title: FACT: Failure-Aware Causal Training for World-Action Models
summary: This research introduces FACT, a failure-aware causal training method for world-action models (WAMs) that co-trains policies with future prediction to provide physical priors for action generation.

title: A Neural Network Based Teleoperation for Remote Controlled Vehicles
summary: This paper proposes a neural network-based teleoperation system for remote-controlled vehicles to overcome critical technical bottlenecks such as communication latency and an operator's inability to perceive environmental disturbances.

title: Real-World Cooperative Bimanual Dexterous Grasp of Large Objects from Single-View Observations
summary: This research addresses the critical challenge of real-world cooperative bimanual dexterous grasping of large objects by robots using single-view observations, which has largely been limited to simulation.

title: PBD-AG: Persistent Baseline-Delta Active Graphs with Uncertainty-Aware Inspection for Long-Horizon Service Robots
summary: This paper introduces PBD-AG, a method for long-horizon service robots to build and revise persistent world models autonomously in unseen environments using uncertainty-aware inspection.

title: Lost in Reconstruction: Aligning Action Representations with Language in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: This research explores how to align action representations with language in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, arguing that numerical proximity in raw action space does not adequately reflect how actions are performed.

title: JitTrack: Onboard Multi-Object Tracking Against Viewpoint Jitter for Agile UAVs
summary: JitTrack is a multi-object tracking system designed for agile unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to mitigate viewpoint jitter caused by camera ego-motion, which can lead to inaccurate target association.

title: BooST: Bridging Semantics and Motions for Efficient Skill Transfer
summary: BooST is a method that bridges semantics and motions for efficient skill transfer in robot learning, aiming to improve sample efficiency and generalization of reusable behaviors for real robots.

title: Toward the Cognitive--Physical Limits of Embodied Intelligence through a World-Model-Centric Autonomous Racing Agent
summary: This research investigates the cognitive-physical limits of embodied intelligence through a world-model-centric autonomous racing agent that perceives, reasons, and acts by interacting with the physical world.

title: When Your State Estimator Has Lost The Plot: Detecting Estimator Failures Via Spectral Analysis
summary: This paper presents a method for detecting estimator failures in robotic systems via spectral analysis, which is essential for safe operation as unmodeled disturbances can degrade state estimation.

title: Robust Sliding Mode and Admittance Control of Underactuated Aerial Manipulators for Contact-Based Inspection
summary: This paper proposes a robust control framework, combining sliding mode and admittance control, for underactuated aerial manipulators to maintain stable interaction during contact-based industrial inspection.

title: TCAM for Autonomous Deformable Manipulation: The RMC2 Champion System for WBCD 2026 Track 4
summary: This technical report describes the RMC2 Team's champion system, TCAM, for the WBCD 2026 Deformable Manipulation Challenge, focusing on a robot's ability to pick, load, align, and smooth a T-shirt.

title: Embodied Multimodal Grounding for Open-Vocabulary Mobile Manipulation via Semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: This research introduces a method for embodied multimodal grounding in open-vocabulary mobile manipulation, allowing robots to align language, visual observations, and 3D scene structure for few-shot tasks.

title: JEPA-WAM: Stage-Level Joint-Embedding Prediction for World-Action Models in Robot Manipulation
summary: JEPA-WAM introduces stage-level joint-embedding prediction for world-action models to improve generalist robot policies by mapping multimodal observations and linguistic instructions to actions across diverse tasks.

title: AECNav: Active Evidence Consolidation for Efficient Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Object Navigation
summary: AECNav is a method for efficient zero-shot open-vocabulary object navigation, enabling a robot to locate arbitrarily specified objects in unseen environments without task-specific training, addressing latency and accuracy.

title: Neural Introspection Gating for Adaptive KV-Cache Reuse in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: This paper proposes Neural Introspection Gating for adaptive KV-cache reuse in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, aiming to improve computational efficiency for real-time control by reducing the recomputation of visual tokens.

title: Flex-$\pi$: A Multi-Stream World-Action Model with Compute Flexibility
summary: Flex-pi is a multi-stream world-action model designed with compute flexibility, extending traditional WAMs to predict beyond RGB latents and incorporate 3D geometry or object semantics for improved future prediction.

title: Seeing above the waves: A modular sensing framework for data acquisition at sea
summary: This paper introduces a modular sensing framework for data acquisition at sea, designed to advance autonomy for surface vessels by addressing challenges of sensor installation and environmental conditions in maritime environments.

title: VIScore: Diagnosing Planning-Relevant Quality in Latent World Models
summary: VIScore is a method for diagnosing the planning-relevant quality of latent world models, studying the connection between their latent space properties, such as isotropic Gaussian distribution, and successful planning outcomes.

title: Risk-Aware Kinodynamic Motion Planning Under Uncertainty For Safe Navigation on Planetary Environments
summary: This research proposes risk-aware kinodynamic motion planning under uncertainty for robotic agents to achieve safe navigation in planetary environments, accounting for unknown environmental interactions and terrain mechanics for wheeled robots.

title: Surgical WAM: A World-Action Model for Data-Efficient Surgical Robot Learning
summary: This paper introduces Surgical WAM, a World-Action Model designed for data-efficient learning of reliable surgical manipulation policies for teleoperated surgical robots, addressing the scarcity of action-labeled demonstrations.

title: Wind-Informed Rapid Flight-Planning in Complex Urban Topologies via Machine Learning and Experimental Validation
summary: This research presents a machine learning-based method for wind-informed rapid flight-planning, enabling aerial vehicles to navigate complex urban environments safely for advanced air mobility operations.

title: Automatic Field-of-View Adjustment for a View-Expansive Microscope via LSTM-Based Gaze and Pipette Motion Interpretation
summary: A new system is proposed for automatic field-of-view adjustment for microscopes, using an LSTM to interpret gaze and pipette motion, thereby streamlining procedures like intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI).

title: Autonomous Exploration-Based Precise Mapping for Mobile Robots through Stepwise and Consistent Motions
summary: This paper presents an autonomous exploration framework for indoor ground mobile robots that uses laser Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) for precise and complete mapping results.

title: X2C: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Nuanced Humanoid Facial Expression Imitation
summary: Introducing X2C, a large-scale benchmark designed to evaluate and improve the fine-grained facial expression imitation capabilities of humanoid agents, addressing the domain gap between biological and mechanical facial dynamics.

title: Learning in ImaginationLand: Omnidirectional Policies through 3D Generative Models (OP-Gen)
summary: This work, 'Omnidirectional Policies through 3D Generative Models (OP-Gen)', demonstrates how recent 3D generative models can augment datasets from single real-world demonstrations to enable omnidirectional policies in robotics.

title: Diffusion-Based Impedance Learning for Contact-Rich Manipulation Tasks
summary: This paper introduces Diffusion-Based Impedance Learning, a framework to improve robot motion generation for contact-rich manipulation tasks by providing stable and safe contact behavior.

title: Injecting Hallucinations in Autonomous Vehicles: A Component-Agnostic Safety Evaluation Framework
summary: Researchers developed a component-agnostic safety evaluation framework to study the impact of perception failures, or 'hallucinations,' on the safety of autonomous vehicles.

title: Influence of Operator Expertise on Robot Supervision and Intervention
summary: This study investigates how varying levels of operator expertise influence the supervision and intervention in robot tasks, aiming to understand diverse user interactions with increasing robot autonomy.

title: Bandwidth-Efficient Multi-Agent Communication through Information Bottleneck and Vector Quantization
summary: This framework combines information bottleneck theory with vector quantization to achieve bandwidth-efficient multi-agent communication, addressing communication constraints in real-world multi-agent reinforcement learning robotics applications.

title: Multisource Human-in-the-Loop Digital Twin Testbed for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles in Mixed Traffic Flow
summary: Introducing MSH-MCCT, a multisource human-in-the-loop digital twin testbed designed for connected and autonomous vehicles (CAVs) to simulate and analyze complex interactions in mixed traffic flow environments.

title: OmniVTA: Visuo-Tactile World Modeling for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
summary: This paper presents OmniVTA, a visuo-tactile world modeling system for contact-rich robotic manipulation tasks, aiming to improve perception beyond vision alone to handle forces and friction.

title: RankFormer: A Propose-then-Select Transformer for Multi-Agent Multimodal Trajectory Prediction
summary: This paper introduces RankFormer, a Propose-then-Select Transformer model for multi-agent multimodal trajectory prediction, which is crucial for applications like autonomous driving.

title: Vision-Language-Motion Maps: An Open-Vocabulary, Uncertainty-Aware, Queryable Motion Attribute for 3D Scene Maps
summary: This research introduces Vision-Language-Motion Maps (VLMM), an open-vocabulary, language-queryable 3D map that allows robots to understand not just 'what and where' but also 'how' scene elements behave.

title: SinD 2.0: A Multi-City UAV Dataset with Semantic Risk Annotations for SOTIF-Oriented Safety Validation at Signalized Intersections
summary: SinD 2.0 is a new multi-city UAV dataset with semantic risk annotations, designed to address the critical bottleneck of safety validation for autonomous driving systems at signalized intersections.

title: X-NavDP: Generalizing Navigation Diffusion Policy to Novel Behavior and Embodiments with Group Q-score Reweighted Matching
summary: This paper introduces X-NavDP, a method to generalize navigation diffusion policies to novel behaviors and robot embodiments using group Q-score reweighted matching, improving generalization beyond single nominal robots.

title: World Action Models in Real Time: An Empirical Study of Smooth Execution via Asynchronous Deployment
summary: This empirical study investigates asynchronous deployment strategies for World Action Models to achieve smooth, real-time robotic execution by overlapping model inference and reducing latency.

summary: Alibaba Cloud has launched its M890 AI supernode instance in China, offering enterprise customers 64-card, high-speed-interconnect computing units. This provides significant cloud compute capacity for AI workloads.

summary: Honor is launching a "Robot Phone" in China, which combines a smartphone with a motorized gimbal camera and AI-assisted subject tracking. This new device represents an AI-enabled consumer electronic product.
